description: Official per-1M-token rates for every model seen in Multica runtime usage. Rates come ONLY from vendor pricing pages; each carries its source URL and capture date. cache_write is the default (5-minute) cache-write rate; cache_write_1h is kept for reference. Edit this file (or point AISTAT_PRICING_OVERRIDES at a second JSON with the same shape) to add or override models without code changes. A model that has no official public rate must be listed with "unpriced": true and a note — never priced at 0. An optional per-model "credits" block gives the OpenAI Codex rate-card credit rates (credits per 1M tokens: input / cache_read / output); when present, cost_credits is computed from it instead of the flat usd*AISTAT_CREDITS_PER_USD conversion. Claude models carry the mapped Codex-tier credit rates (Fable 5 = GPT-5.6 Sol; Opus 4.8 and Opus 5 = GPT-5.6 Terra) per owner directives FAN-1427 and FAN-1715. GPT-5.6 rates are Standard / short-context rates; usage has no service-tier or context-length discriminator for Fast or long-context pricing.
assumptions: Multica runtime usage reports four token counts per (runtime, model, day): input / output / cache_read / cache_write. input_tokens is the uncached remainder, so total cost = input*input + output*output + cache_read*cache_read + cache_write*cache_write, all per 1M tokens.

cache_write tokens are priced at the vendor's default 5-minute cache-write rate (Anthropic 1.25x input; OpenAI gpt-5.6 1.25x input). Agents use the default ephemeral (5m) cache, so the 5m rate is the correct default; the 1h rate is recorded for reference/override.
cache_read tokens are priced at the vendor cache-hit rate (Anthropic 0.1x input; OpenAI cached-input 0.1x input).

credits (OpenAI Codex rate card, https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001106-codex-rate-card, captured 2026-07-30) are per 1M tokens and cover input / cached input (cache_read) / output only; cache_write is not part of the credit card. Credit cost = (input*credits.input + cache_read*credits.cache_read + output*credits.output) / 1e6.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: Claude Opus 4.8. 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read (hit) = 0.1x input.

credits.notes: Credits billed as GPT-5.6 Terra per owner directive FAN-1427.

claude-opus-5.notes: Claude Opus 5. Uses the same 5m/1h cache and cache-read rates as Claude Opus 4.8 by owner directive FAN-1715; the model ID remains distinct.

credits.notes: Credits billed as GPT-5.6 Terra, matching Claude Opus 4.8, per owner directive FAN-1715.

claude-fable-5.notes: Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic's most capable widely released model). 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input.

credits.notes: Credits billed as GPT-5.6 Sol per owner directive FAN-1427.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: Claude Sonnet 5 at introductory pricing, in effect through 2026-08-31. Standard pricing (input 3.0, output 15.0, cache_read 0.30, cache_write 3.75, cache_write_1h 6.0) takes effect 2026-09-01 — update this entry then; recompute reprices all history at the flat current rate. 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input. No credits block: no owner directive maps Sonnet to a Codex credit tier.

claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Claude Sonnet 4.6. 5m cache write = 1.25x input; 1h = 2x; cache read = 0.1x input.
